info.name: Cleanora R1-P02 Authentication
info.description:
Canonical R1-P02 Auth API collection. It contains exactly one request per implemented method and route. Error cases such as duplicate signup identifiers, invalid credentials, weak passwords, and invalid OTPs are response examples in Swagger, not fake API requests. Refresh credentials remain in the cookie jar and secrets remain empty in exported environments.

> ⚠️ **Hey Bassam, you can visit Swagger docs here, my bro:** http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs ⚠️

Railway Swagger: https://cleanora-production.up.railway.app/api/v1/docs

request.description: Creates an account and stores challengeId. In local development, the Individual phone OTP is emailed to the normalized testEmail; the client cannot override the recipient. Possible 400/409/429/503 responses are documented in Swagger.

request.description: Requests/resends the existing challenge. Cooldown applies. Possible invalid, expired, and rate-limit responses are in Swagger.

request.description: Consumes the six-digit account verification code. Invalid, expired, used, mismatched, and exhausted challenges share the documented safe error.

request.description: Creates a session, stores accessToken, and returns the canonical safe user. The refresh token is only an HttpOnly cookie. Invalid credentials are documented as a 401 response in Swagger.

request.description: JSON inspection endpoint. For a real Chrome flow use Start Google Browser Sign-In so the same browser owns the correlation cookie.

request.description: Open this URL as top-level browser navigation. It redirects to Google and must not be started in Postman then continued in Chrome.

Provider-owned browser callback. Google supplies state/code. On success the backend writes the refresh cookie and redirects to frontendUrl/auth/google/callback with safe markers only. Do not manually send it in normal Postman testing.
Requires a verification-only Google Bearer session. The temporary phone OTP recipient is derived only from the linked verified Google email; no email field is accepted.
